rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload trip when healthy signal X13 is lost.
Reset latched fault M190 on fault reset pushbutton X1.
Set common fault M199 if latched fault, motor overload, or E-stop is tripped.
Run conveyor motor Y10 when auto mode is selected and no fault is active.
Indicate pallet in position M100 from pallet stop photo-eye X10.
Energize and latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on pallet release request X14.
Time stopper release duration for 2.0 s using timer T11 while Y11 is active.
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 once 2.0 s timer T11 completes.
